in_game_description: Ores can be obtained through mining asteroids. Ore is not found in every system.
mechanics_text: 10t required for M6 A3 "Wolverine" blueprint; 40t required for Gunant's Drill blueprint.
In the Supernova DLC, Keith is required to mine 100t of Titanium (140t on Android).
One of three minerals in the game that can be found on Earth (the others being Iron and Gold).
Most common deep in Vossk territory.
